name: Entity Model
description: Adds annotation-based entity type and bundle models for entities.
project_description: Entity Model lets developers register Drupal entity type and bundle classes through a @Model plugin (annotation or PHP attribute) placed in a module's Entity namespace, instead of implementing hook_entity_type_alter() / hook_entity_bundle_info_alter() by hand. A plugin manager discovers these classes and the module's own hook implementations swap the entity type or bundle class accordingly. It also ships developer conveniences: automatic injection of model entities into controller (and optionally FormState) arguments via a value resolver, an optional AccountProxy override that makes current_user::getAccount() return the full User entity, translatable entity-reference field item list classes, and FieldHelpers / EntityTranslatorTrait helper traits. A drush entity_model:list command reports which bundles are mapped to which model classes. There is no admin UI; the two optional features are toggled in the entity_model.settings config object.
